verdict.rationale: The repo documents an in-agent marketplace flow: register the marketplace with `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, then install a collection with `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`. The docs say a plugin is something Claude Code "installs and loads as one unit." A hands-on probe also confirmed the repo's skills install cleanly into ./.claude/skills via the third-party `npx skills add` tool, but that tool is not the product's own install path. Missing for 10: the documented path takes two commands (marketplace add plus install) rather than a true one-liner, no evidence explicitly confirms the skills are active in the next session, and there is no first-party hands-on corroboration of the /plugin install path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: A Claude Code plugin is a directory of skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, or other components that Claude Code installs and loads as one unit.
anyone with access registers it in Claude Code with one command and installs your plugins from it.
